title: cubic wonder
description: Unfinished. Has some Optifine stuff, custom models, 32x, and more
body:
32x resource pack worked on during 2019-2020, wasn't finished

Highlight features:
- Custom models for certain plants
- Custom tool item models
- Specialized textures for fences
- Custom enchantment table / beacon models

Optifine/MCPatcher support:
- Random textures for ores
- Custom biome colors for some block types (dirt,sand,snow,water)
- Blending overlay textures (gravel,sand)
- Tiled textures (dirt,sand,redsand,gravel,obsidian,stone)
- Jungle vines
- Custom lightmap
- Custom glints for different enchantments
- Custom chest model with a rounded lid
- Custom night sky with a dark blue horizon

And some more

If you continue this work, please credit me including a link to this page + let me know you've done so (I'm new to submitting to Modrinth so I don't know much of how this would work) i'm also ok with updating this submission with a continued version
